missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Удовольствие' is the neuter noun in the nominative as the predicate. 'Настоящее' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'было' marks the past tense.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Удовольствие' is the accusative direct object of 'доставляет'. 'Большое' agrees in the neuter, and 'мне' is the dative recipient of the pleasure.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Удовольствия' is the genitive form required by 'ради', expressing reading for the sake of pleasure. 'Книги' stays accusative as the object read.
Strategic focus: Genitive of cause. 'Удовольствия' is the genitive form after 'от', expressing the cause of the shouting. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Удовольствием' is the instrumental form in the fixed phrase 'с удовольствием', a polite way to agree gladly. 'Тебе' is the dative recipient of help.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Удовольствиях' is the prepositional plural after 'о'. 'Простых' is the agreeing plural adjective, naming the everyday pleasures discussed.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Удовольствий' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Маленьких' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в жизни' gives the setting.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Удовольствие' stays nominative as the subject. 'От работы' specifies its source, and 'важно' is the neuter short-form predicate.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Удовольствия' is the genitive form after 'для', expressing singing for her own pleasure. 'Своего' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative exclamation. 'Удовольствие' is nominative in an exclamatory phrase. 'Какое' is the agreeing neuter interrogative-exclamative, expressing delight in walking here.
